Hello everyone!
Welcome to the North Clwyd Animal Rescue channel. With the goal of sustainable development and spreading useful values. In addition to inspirational videos about animal love. Our channel will make videos to save and rescue animals that have been injured or abused by raising welfare funds dedicated to helping non-profit animal rescue organizations around the world.
Hopefully they will really bring value to the audience and help you relieve stress after a day of work.
Thank you everyone!
Thank you for your cooperation.
